notes.title: V1.1.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed practice mode pause menu having strange behavior
[*] Fixed practice mode scores being added to the previously played mode's leaderboard
[*] Fixed combo multiplier carrying over from practice mode to main game
[*] Fixed bug where graze multiplier wouldn't be correct on start
[*] Fixed bug where player power level would not be correct on loading a Checkpoint_MODE save
[/list]

[*] Added score to end credits and death menu
[*] Control rebinds save

[*] Arcade mode has 3 continues

[*] Fixed player becoming invincible after resetting

[*] Added shoot and back for navigation
[*] Added shoot and back for navigation
